name: std::num_put<CharT,OutputIt>::~num_put
intro: Destructs a std::num_put facet. This destructor is protected and virtual (due to base class destructor being virtual). An object of type std::num_put, like most facets, can only be destroyed when the last std::locale object that implements this facet goes out of scope or if a user-defined class is derived from std::num_put and implements a public destructor.
